result.description: A fictional decorative kinetic sculpture designed for indoor courtyards and sheltered porches, the Lumen Arcadia 42-bell Restorative Wind Chime pairs anodized aluminum tubes with a weighted maple striker for a soft, layered tonal pattern. It is intended for ambient soundscapes rather than computing, storage, or electronics use. The piece ships with a stainless suspension ring, weather-resistant cord, and a fixed-tuning frame that emphasizes resonance over volume. Not a consumer tech device; this is a home decor and acoustics object.
result.title: Lumen Arcadia 42-bell Restorative Wind Chime
